name: Toudou Reika
source:
While attending school as an active student, she also works as a professional idol voice actor. She lives alone in the city away from her parents. She tends to be absent from classes because her voice actor work is prioritized. With her cold atmosphere keeping people away, she is isolated in class. She is extremely lonely and suffers from the loneliness of living alone along with the stress of work.

She has a lot of pride. To her Yuuji and the Tomefure system are mentally divided into "systems only for maintaining the mentality necessary for her work". Because she usually has a haughty attitude, she is overreactive when frustrated by work or relationships.
